description:
## Scope

In pkix-difftest/src/corpus/pkits.rs, when loading a PKITS testcase, also load the CRLs referenced by the cert chain and populate Chain.crls.

## What

- PKITS testcase loader currently extracts the chain certs.
- PKITS test vectors (vectors.json or vector.json depending on PKITS version) include a 'crls' list per testcase. Loader must:
  - Read the CRL filenames from the testcase metadata.
  - Load each as DER from pkix-difftest/.../pkix-path/tests/pkits/crls/<name>.crl.
  - Set chain.crls = vec_of_der.
- If the PKITS test corpus doesn't list CRLs per testcase, infer them from the chain (one CRL per CA cert's DN match). Fall back to walking pkits/crls/ if needed.

## Acceptance

- [ ] PKITS loader populates Chain.crls when CRLs are referenced by the testcase.
- [ ] Existing testcases without CRLs still load with chain.crls.is_empty().
- [ ] At least one PKITS §4.4 testcase ends up with chain.crls non-empty.

## Depends on

PKIX-emf1.1.

## Parent

PKIX-emf1.
title: PKITS corpus loader: thread CRL bytes through Chain
